rag.text:
Test: TC-4788 — Global - Resources - Individuals - Bulk assignment in Individuals tab
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-63 Global - Resources Manager
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Administration → Resources → Individuals
   Expected: Individuals tab is displayed
2. Click on Assign to dropdown
   Expected: Following options are displayed in the dropdown:

Workload plan

Holiday plan
3. Click on Workload plan
   Expected: Modal window Assign individuals to workload plan is displayed with following options:

* Workload plan (red asterisk) with ‘Select workload plan’ placeholder
* Efficiency (red asterisk) is set to 1 by default
* Start date (red asterisk) tooltip 'End date will be adjusted automatically' below
* Users (red asterisk) with ‘Select user’ placeholder
4. Select workloadPlan, startDate and then click on Users dropdown
   Data: workloadPlan: TC-4788A

startDate: 01/Jul/24
   Expected: List of users is displayed

Select all and Deselect all is displayed at the top of the list. Extplatform icon is displayed next to user names.
5. Type userName in selector
   Data: userName: TC-4788
   Expected: Following users are displayed on the list: 

* TC-4788
* TC-4788user
* TC-4788user2
6. Click on the checkboxes next to userNames, click out of the window
   Data: userNames: TC-4788, TC-4788user, TC-4788user2
   Expected: Users are selected and displayed in Users selector
7. Click on (x) icon next to userName
   Data: userName: TC-4788
   Expected: User TC-4788 is deleted. Users TC-4788user and TC-4788user2 are displayed in the Users selector
8. Click assign
   Expected: Modal window is closed
9. Click on Assign to dropdown
   Expected: Following options are displayed in the dropdown:

Workload plan

Holiday plan
10. Click on Holiday plan
   Expected: Modal window Assign individuals to holiday plan is displayed with following options:

* Holiday plan (red asterisk) with ‘Select holiday plan’ placeholder
* Start date (red asterisk) tooltip ‘End date will be adjusted automatically based on start date of the previous plan’ below
* Users (red asterisk) with ‘Select user’ placeholder
11. Select holidayPlan, startDate and then click on Users dropdown
   Data: holidayPlan: TC-4788A

startDate: 01/Jul/24
   Expected: List of users is displayed

Select all and Deselect all is displayed at the top of the list. Extplatform icon is displayed next to user names.
12. Type userName in selector
   Data: userName: TC-4788
   Expected: Following users are displayed on the list: 

* TC-4788
* TC-4788user
* TC-4788user2
13. Click on the checkboxes next to userNames, click out of the window
   Data: userNames: TC-4788user, TC-4788user2
   Expected: Users are selected and displayed in Users selector
14. Click assign
   Expected: Modal window is closed
15. Refresh the page.
Click on three dots next to Full Name, type userName and select
   Data: userName: TC-4788user
   Expected: USer TC-4788user is selected
16. Click on userName
   Data: userName: TC-4788user
   Expected: Following data is displayed in Resource Details:

Holiday plan TC-4788A starts at 01/Jul/2024

Workload plan TC-4788A starts at 01/Jul/2024
